notes.title: Alpha version of Skeleboy is now live!
notes.content: [h1]ALPHA TESTING IS NOW LIVE[/h1][p]People say it's never too early for developers to playtest a game. Since I've been at this for about 15 months, I'd say it's about time. Feel free to try out the [b]first world [/b]in Skeleboy, and let me know what you think! Send comments in-game by pressing [i]T[/i].[/p][p]I know it's more of a beta, since I'm opening it up to unknown players but it is the same version I used for in-house testing. (friends and family lol)[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://deklaration.itch.io/skeleboy" style="button" buttoncolor="#800080"]Download the game here![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Known bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Rare paints are too common as rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]A road may be drawn between stages you haven't reached.[/p][/*][*][p]It is possible to slip through the obsticles when fighting The Howling One.[/p][/*][*][p]The game will softlock if you, in some way, beat Hypnox or Gullveig.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]
